_comment: Instruments replaced by one with a DIFFERENT name. Same-name replacements (e.g. SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations 1992 -> 2015) are found automatically from embedding/legislation_labels.json and need no entry here. 'mention' is a case-insensitive regular expression for how the old instrument is written in text; 'unless' (optional) is a regular expression that, when it also matches, means the passage covers the current law too.

instruments.title: Foreign Exchange Management (Transfer or Issue of Security by a Person Resident Outside India) Regulations, 2017
instruments.mention: transfer or issue of security by a person resident outside india\)?\s*regulations,?\s*(?:2000|2017)|FEMA\s*20\s*(?:\(R\))?(?:\s*/\s*20\d\d)?

instruments.title: Foreign Exchange Management (Acquisition and Transfer of Immovable Property in India) Regulations, 2018
instruments.mention: acquisition and transfer of immovable property in india\)?\s*regulations,?\s*(?:2000|2018)

instruments.title: SEBI (Disclosure and Investor Protection) Guidelines, 2000
instruments.successor: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
instruments.unless: issue of capital and disclosure requirements

instruments.title: Listing Agreement (Clause 49 and other clauses)
instruments.successor: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
